# Symbols Nerd Font

- **Version:** Nerd Fonts 3.5.1, "Symbols Only", Regular.
- **Source:** <https://github.com/ryanoasis/nerd-fonts>, `patched-fonts/NerdFontsSymbolsOnly/SymbolsNerdFont-Regular.ttf`, downloaded 2026-09-26.
- **What it is:** the icons of the Nerd Fonts project, with no letters. The engine puts it after a text font in a fallback stack (`engine_text::fonts::NERD_SYMBOLS`), which gives the same result as a "Nerd Font" version of that font without modifying the text font.
- **Changes:** none (unmodified).
- **License:**
  - The font and the Nerd Fonts scripts: MIT, © 2014 Ryan L McIntyre (see `LICENSE`).
  - The icons keep the licenses of their sets, listed below from the project's own table (`patched-fonts/NerdFontsSymbolsOnly/README.md`, `license-audit.md`).
  - OFL-1.1 and CC BY 4.0 are allowed for fonts and icons by ADR 0036; every set is credited in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.
